subject.title: fix(macos): offer CLI channels for unreleased builds

question: Should this PR wait for real macOS proof of both a debug Dev installation and the subsequent stable-build exact-version recovery path?
rationale: The source and Swift tests cover the policy branches, but repository policy requires after-fix real behavior proof for this external, user-visible installation and upgrade flow.

options.title: Require live upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording demonstrates both successful Dev installation and stable-build recovery.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Explicitly accept the source and automated tests as sufficient while owning the remaining native macOS upgrade uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until redacted terminal output, runtime logs, or a recording demonstrates both successful Dev installation and stable-build recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the affected macOS CLI flow, authored this correction, and is the current assignee.
